title: Disclaimer.
bodyText: A beneficiary may disclaim all or part of the beneficiary's interest as provided by chapter 526, the Uniform Disclaimer of Property Interests Act.
bodyHtml: [§527‑14]  Disclaimer.  A beneficiary may disclaim all or part of the beneficiary's interest as provided by chapter 526, the Uniform Disclaimer of Property Interests Act. [L 2011, c 173, pt of §1]
